Devil's Sight

Spell

3rd level Transmutation
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self
Components: V, S
Duration: 1 hour (concentration)

Be given the eyes of a devil, allowing yourself to see in normal and magical darkness up to 60 ft.

Spell Lists: Sorcerer (Fiendblade)
